dedupe_keys.name: epa food waste management life cycle inventory tool v1 0 0

description: This Excel model generates life-cycle inventories for US food-waste treatment through anaerobic digestion, windrow or aerated-static-pile composting, landfilling and incineration. The US EPA combines literature and government-report parameters with engineering calculations, allowing default or user-specified process values. Options include biogas and landfill-gas uses and digestate treatment. Data.gov provides the EPA-hosted model archive; the linked EPA licence states public-domain status for its data, with free public access. Coverage represents average US activities and configurable static scenarios, not a dated facility operating record. Outputs appear in the LCI worksheet and can be exported as CSV. A material limitation is that land application credits include avoided fertiliser and carbon storage, while associated emissions are assumed equivalent to displaced fertiliser emissions. Modellers could generate process inventories for waste-system simulation and assessment. platform-brightway-lca, platform-openlca and model-epa-warm-waste-reduction-model are related tools. No workbook, archive or default calculation was downloaded or executed.
